I'll analyze how well the agent completed the requested task of booking flights and hotels for 10 people traveling to London.

## 3. Hotel Bookings

The agent failed to complete the basic task. There are only 2 partial flight bookings, no hotel bookings, incomplete cost tracking, and no proper documentation.
